title: Jonah and the Colony
author: Mirabel Ravensworth
blurb: Gideon Iversen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
